name: Resolve-DnsName
title: Test Windows DNS resolution
summary: Queries DNS and displays the records returned for a hostname or domain.

examples.description: Queries the configured DNS service for the host's records.

permissions.notes: DNS queries normally do not require elevation.

risk.warning: This command reads DNS data and does not change resolver settings.

output_fields.name: Type
output_fields.description: DNS record type such as A, AAAA, or CNAME.

output_fields.name: IPAddress
output_fields.description: Address returned for an address record.

common_errors.meaning: The resolver returned NXDOMAIN or the name was entered incorrectly.
The DNS server could not complete the request.
